import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Load data
print("Loading train data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)

print("Loading test data...")
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Identify target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
id_col = "Id"
features_train = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in [id_col, target_col]]
features_test = [col for col in test_df.columns if col == id_col or col not in [id_col]]

# Ensure feature alignment
# In case of slight mismatch, ensure test dataframe has exactly the feature columns from train
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[id_col, target_col])
X_test = test_df.copy()

# Drop columns that might be present in test but not train, or vice versa (keep intersection)
common_features = list(set(X_train.columns) & set(X_test.columns))
X_train = X_train[common_features]
X_test = X_test[common_features]

y_train = train_df[target_col]

# Handle missing values if any (simple imputation or drop)
# Given synthetic nature, fill numerical with median, categoricals with mode if object types
# Assuming standard types for initial attempt
print("Splitting data for validation...")
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Initialize and train model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    max_depth=-1,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    verbose=-1,
)
model.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

# Compute hold-out validation accuracy
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"\nValidation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for submission
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Prepare submission file
submission_data = (
    pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_df[id_col], target_col: y_test_pred})
    .sort_values(id_col)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Save submission
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submission_data.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.4f}")
